title: start's host-setup warning tells a url's host from a host setup, and set can record host_unchecked on a gate
goal: bl_plan's HOST_WORDS warning at start no longer fires on 'host' used as a url's host (a routes-table or web host), and backlog.py set or gate gives a way to record a gate's host_unchecked reason on an existing gate, so a start warning can be acted on. Answers SP-evkj4avq, where start warned of ST-5zpbfax2 gate g1 for the word host in a url sense, and no command could record the reason (a note was refused as longer than TEXT_MAX).
